description: Permanently delete a webhook. Any monitor still pointing at it will fail to deliver until repointed at a different webhook -- this does NOT cascade-delete or pause the monitors using it. Cannot be undone. Returns 404 `webhook_not_found` if the id does not exist or is not yours.

id.description: The webhook's id, from reddit_monitor_webhook_create's response or reddit_monitor_webhook_list.

name: reddit_monitor_webhook_delete
